Dear County Commissioners:
The Laramie County Early Childhood Education and Development Joint Powers Board
was formed to administer a SLIB grant that was applied for in 2009 that would have built
a new Child Development Centerin the Cheyenne Business Park.The grantwas not
approved by the SLIB board and with no other existing business or new business for the
Board to address we are requesting the dissolution of this Joint Powers Board.
Theboard has not met in quite some time and there are no financial obligations
outstanding.The Board members agree that the dissolution of the Joint Powers Board
would be best for all entities involved.
When the Laramie County Early Childhood Education and Development Joint Powers
Board wasformed, no operating funds were provided by the College and/or the two
governmental entities(Laramie County and City of Cheyenne)involved.
Any questions regarding this request for dissolution can be referred to Mr.Rod Hottle at
307-638-8904, ext.15.
Sincerely,
Rod Hottle
Secretary
